column1: # Extras for lattice-keys, the SUPER + / cheatsheet (lattice's modules/nixos/desktop/menus.nix).
# Most of the sheet is read live -- Hyprland binds with a description, tmux binds with a note
# (-N), nvim maps with a desc -- so the place to put a key on it is normally its own config.
# This file is for the rest: things no config can report, a few tmux defaults worth seeing
# (defaults are left out, or the sheet would be all tmux), and rows to drop.
# Tab-separated: <section> <keys> <description>. A description of "-" hides that row
# instead, matched on section and keys exactly as the sheet shows them.
# Not binds: a Hyprland gesture and the MX Master's Solaar rules (~/.config/solaar/rules.yaml).
